title: Disney Mickey Mouse Halloween Pumpkin Plush Stuffed Animal Toy 6" Disneyland
descriptionText: The Disney Mickey Mouse Halloween Pumpkin Plush Stuffed Animal Toy is a 6" small-sized toy from the Mickey Mouse & Friends character family. Made in China, this adorable plush features the iconic Disney character Mickey Mouse in a Halloween pumpkin design. Perfect for young fans of Disney and Halloween, this plush toy is a cute and cuddly addition to any collection.
